programmes.d: The sisters still have unresolved issues, but they reunite after finding out their mom needs surgery. Trina secretly files for divorce but doesn't want to tell the sisters. Traci's son reveals he's engaged!
The team's personal and professional life crashes together.

Sisters are stressed when Mama Evelyn faces major surgery, and Tamar panics when she can't be there. After Trina's court appearance, the family is fearful when she reveals shocking details of the divorce.
Lacey takes on a new case, but has ulterior motives. Daniel tells Lacey about a possible new witness, but Lacey doubts his credibility.

In a messy divorce, Trina and her sons have just days to move out of their home. Tamar feels left out by her sisters. Traci stresses about her son's engagement. She preps for a showcase and has a panic attack!
Lacey announces she's defending Deputy Garcia, but it proves to more than she bargained for. Things are further complicated when Othello gets another offer.

Traci panics before her showcase. Toni is honored with an award in Atlanta; sisters wonder where's Tamar? Trina brings a mystery date to her superhero-themed 40th birthday party. Tamar feels out of the loop.
Lacey's enemies plot their revenge. Othello considers a compelling offer. Mark gets stunning news about Zoe. With the pressure mounting, Lacey begins to unravel.

Sisters come to LA as Toni gets ready for the Grammy Awards. Trina goes on her first date since filing for divorce. Tamar wants to reconnect with her sisters but it backfires when her Atlanta concert comes up.
Lana & Mekhi's father visits. Luscious T gets in trouble.
Luscious T's best friend comes to visit. Mekhi gets scammed

Evelyn pushes the sisters to work out their issues, but they stay silent. Trina breaks down about her divorce. Tamar works on a new album. Toni preps for a show in Miami; Traci shocks sisters with her behavior.
Luscious T dates an artist, frustrating Lana.

Traci's behavior in Miami concerns family; worries about her drinking. Tamar judges on RuPaul's Drag Race. Sisters panic on alligator tour! Tamar feels threatened, and misses a big event for Toni's son Diezel.
While Todd introduces Mr. O'Dell to professional e-gaming, Jaheem has to puppeteer Bernie after a bad mix of pills and Travis' new energy drink.

After Tamar misses an important family event, she defends herself to the sisters. A major blowup splits the family. Parents insist on a counseling session with well-known spiritual advisor Bishop T.D. Jakes.
Travis tries to get his reputation back after being cancelled and Fitz goes into hiding when his NFT for Youngblood Felon gets hacked.

Bishop T.D. Jakes gives harsh criticism to the sisters. Daddy surprises everyone with an RV trip to an amusement park. Trina stresses over her next court date for her divorce and gets ready for a major fight.
It's all hands on deck when the building needs to get up to code and Bernie enters a competition against his estranged sister.

Trina faces final divorce decisions and stresses over Bar Chix. The sisters grill Trina's new man Jacent. Tamar gets feedback from the sisters on her single. Traci's pushed to finally deal with her issues.
Todd gets distracted from his e-gaming by a beautiful new girlfriend and Mercedes gets her first big role, but not everything is as perfect as it seems.

Traci confronts the sisters. Tamar promotes her spring fashion line in NYC. Trina recruits bartenders. Toni invites Traci to sing during her show at a major jazz festival. Traci is overwhelmed at soundcheck.
Fritz explores taking his relationship with Ashley further.

Traci performs at Toni's show; all the sisters are there. Trina's new man meets Daddy. Traci confronts her son and his fiancee. Trina's search for bartenders. Tamar throws a party for Logan's second birthday.
Ashley invites Fritz to Thanksgiving dinner with her family.

The sisters get competitive on Family Feud. Tamar shocks Evelyn with her new video. Traci forces Kevin Jr. and fiancee to care for a fake baby. Trina goes barhopping with potential Bar Chix; things get wild.
Fritz gets confronted about his backslide.

Tamar is concerned that Trina's boyfriend wants a private meeting with their father. Towanda shocks all with her role in a new theater project. Sisters attend Trina's test run for Bar Chix; bartender blows up.
Brittany senses a rift within her love triangle.

After another stressful delay with Bar Chix, Trina's relationship takes a major turn. Tamar has ambitious photo shoot for her new album, but wardrobe is all wrong. Toni proposes Christmas album with sisters.
Carissa is tormented by her ugly past.
Law enforcement starts to close in on the family's crimes.

Trina finds out what's inside secret box from Jacent. Towanda and Trina have news for Toni. Sisters start to work on Toni's Christmas album, but busy schedules and past issues stir up drama. Traci storms out.
Jupiter goes to Nigeria for peace. Carissa and Dante bond.

Evelyn suffers from a stroke, which turns into an East Coast vs. West Coast sister battle over Mommy! Evelyn's near death experience sparks a new lease on life while Traci faces a health scare of her own.
Sammy's pressured while his protege makes moves.

Trina hires a matchmaker for Mommy in Atlanta. Toni craves new experiences and takes the plunge. Tamar wants the Hollywood Medium, Tyler Henry to connect with angels, but Trina is not on board & tension rises.

After a rollercoaster of emotions, tensions are high.
